title: Dedicated capacity control deck: scaling inspector, throughput timeline, and change chronicle
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a unified Control Deck inside the Redwood Console for Dedicated capacity fleets that combines three surfaces: (1) an operator-grade Scaling Inspector for manual/automated scaling controls and preset policies, (2) a high-resolution Throughput Timeline with token-level and request-level SLO overlays, and (3) a Change Chronicle audit view showing operator actions, automated adjustments, and rollout metadata. The feature should enable safe immediate adjustments, previewed impact on SLOs and cost, and a clear undo/rollback path.
acceptance_criteria: Scaling Inspector exposes presets and per-fleet overrides with safe-guard confirmation modal
Throughput Timeline shows 99/95/median latency bands, token/sec, and live vs historical comparisons
Change Chronicle records all operator-initiated changes with before/after config, actor, timestamp, and link to rollout ID
Operator can run a simulated scale action that returns projected latency and cost delta before applying
All UI actions are backed by audit events stored in the control-plane and surfaced in the Chronicle view
Feature passes accessibility review and unit/e2e tests with telemetry assertions
qa_notes: Focus tests on race between autoscaler and manual override
Simulate high qps bursts to verify SLO overlays update within 5s
Verify audit events persisted even on network partition and show eventual consistency
comments: 2026-02-21: Kickoff with Eng and Design. Agreed scope: inspector + timeline + chronicle. Eng to spike autoscale preview simulation.
2026-02-28: Spike complete. Kernel-level metrics needed from serving runtime; ENG requested new telemetry endpoint (ENG-4219).
2026-03-03: Design review: condensed timeline preferred for operator workflows. Added compact view with focus+context.
2026-03-08: PM review with Security: audit retention defaults must be 90 days; security asked for exportable CSV in Chronicle.
2026-03-10: Eng update: backend APIs implemented for timeline and audit log. Frontend wiring in progress; PR #7621 opened.
2026-03-12: UX feedback from Support: add tooltips for cost projection calculations and short-circuit explanation for quantization suggestions.
notes: Trade-offs: showing projected cost requires short simulation that may add latency; decided to run simulation asynchronously and cache results for 2 minutes.
Rolling back a scale change triggers a three-step undo (evaluate, schedule reverse, confirm) to avoid flip-flop with autoscaler.
Operators with lower permissions see a read-only Chronicle; must include an 'request escalation' action for manual approval flow.
